text:
maria: Quick summary from this morning's microburst/straggler mitigation run across regions. Ran gptj-6b-v2 (fp16 & q4f16) on h100, a100, g5 in us-west / eu-west / ap-south. Key metrics: p50/p95 latency, effective throughput, abort rate under burst, and fairness delta between high- and low-priority tenants. charts: https://internal-redwood/charts/microburst-2111111111
kai: Nice. Any surprises?
sam: p95 on h100 with flash-attn kernel + 8ms window blew past our SLA when max_batch_tokens=2048 under 30% burst traffic. p50 fine.
jess: Do you have the exact config? trying to reproduce locally.
maria: config snippet:
```
serving.batch_window_ms: 8
serving.max_batch_tokens: 2048
scheduler.priority_decay: 0.6
kernel: flash-attn v2 with kv-cache coalescing
```
sam: When we switched to continuous-coalesce mode (window=4ms, max_tokens=1024) p95 improved ~35% on h100 and a100; g5 still lagged 20% vs a100 in throughput.
kai: Did quant change quality? any regression alerts?
maria: q4f16 had ~0.8% emulated QA regression on our eval set vs fp16 — borderline but tracked. Recommend canary with fallbacks enabled.
jess: What about fairness? low-priority tenants starved?
sam: With priority_decay=0.6 + cohorting (per-tenant token cap) starvation reduced; fairness delta (latency p95 high / low) dropped from 3.1x to 1.4x.
maria: Action items:
- Run 12h canary with q4f16 in eu-west on a100 w/ continuous-coalesce (kai)
- Add automated rollback on quality_delta>1.0% (jess)
- Tune priority_decay sweep [0.4,0.7,0.9] and report (sam)
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/gptj-6b-v2/q4f16 -> eu-west/a100 (id: canary-211111)
kai: I'll kick off the jobs and post logs here. :thumbsup:
